alphabet.name: reh with small v below - trilled r
lam with small v - velarized l
yeh with small v - long e

contextual_rules.rule: ه + ZWNJ -> ە; in legacy-encoded text word-final ه -> ە
micro-spaces -> ZWNJ; ZWNJ kept only between two joining letters
ەە -> ە, ڕڕ -> ڕ, ڵڵڵ -> ڵڵ, ووو -> وو, یییی -> ییی; ڵڵ (ئەڵڵا), ییی (سنەییی) and ر+ڕ, ل+ڵ stay

semivowel_resolution: و / ی after a vowel letter -> /w/ /j/
و / ی before a vowel letter -> /w/ /j/ (onset cluster Cw / Cj)
و between consonants or word-finally -> /u/; ی -> /iː/
وو -> /uː/; after a vowel یی -> /jiː/, after a consonant a surface /iː/ (an ezafe or clitic ی is not a separate vowel); a glide is inserted before a following vowel

phonotactics.bizroke: an epenthetic /ɯ/ breaks every other cluster, carved right-to-left

verbs.alignment: past tenses of transitive verbs are ergative: the agent is cross-referenced by a set-2 enclitic
